## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs`)
- [ ] Refactor / tooling (`refactor` / `chore` / `ci`)

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `uv run ruff check src tests` passes.
- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check src tests` passes.
- [ ] `uv run pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] I added/updated tests for my change.
- [ ] I updated docs (`README.md`) if behaviour or usage changed.
- [ ] My PR is focused on a single logical change.
